people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

people.name: Haman
people.line: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

translations.web: Esther said, “If it seems good to the king, let the king and Haman come today to the banquet that I have prepared for him.”
translations.bsb: “If it pleases the king,” Esther replied, “may the king and Haman come today to the banquet I have prepared for the king.”
translations.kjv: And Esther answered, If it seem good unto the king, let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared
translations.asv: And Esther said, If it seem good unto the king, let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him.
